description: This file defines an interface class IApplicationManagementServer for managing application sessions in a media server context. It declares virtual methods for initialization, event notification, starting, and stopping the server, and includes necessary headers and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: IApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: An interface class for application management server operations, including initialization, event handling, and control methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the server with a socket descriptor.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to notify about session server state changes.
